Fischedick, M., Marzinkowski, J., Winzer, P. and Weigel, M. (2014). Techno-economic evaluation of innovative steel production technologies. Journal of Cleaner Production 84, 563-580. doi:10.1016/j.jclepro.2014.05.063

Journal pages 563-580 (PDF p.1 = journal p.563); locators are PRINTED journal pages. Loaded: four route models per t crude steel (BF-BOF, BF-TGR-CCS, hydrogen DR-EAF, electrowinning-EAF): energy demand by carrier (Fig. 3 printed labels, LHV), CAPEX (Tables A-3 to A-6, EUR2010 per t capacity, greenfield, reprinted from Woertler et al. 2013), maintenance at 3% of CAPEX (derived), total CO2 per t CS for the moderate scenario 2050 (Figure-A 1; scenario dependent), year of market entry, ore/coal/scrap inputs (Figure-A 1). Not loaded: price projections (Table-A 1), EBIT/NPV results (charts), step energies (other-values; per t CS not per t intermediate). Traps: whole-route values per t crude steel including upstream reducing-agent production (coal mining, H2 electrolysis); EW CAPEX components 184 + 340 do not sum to the printed 639; H-DR uses a fluidised bed (Circored), not a shaft.
